changeSet.id: Populate specimen stats using collection receive details
changeSet.sql:
create procedure populate_specimen_stats() begin insert into tmp_specimen_stats ( specimen_id, collection_time, collection_procedure_id, collection_container_id, collector_id, received_time, received_quality_id, receiver_id, frozen_time, processing_time, ischemia_time, specimen_seq ) select c.identifier as specimen_id, crd.collection_time, crd.collection_procedure_id, crd.collection_container_id, crd.collection_user_id, crd.received_time, crd.received_quality_id, crd.received_user_id, fe.event_timestamp as frozen_time, timestampdiff(MINUTE, crd.received_time, fe.event_timestamp) as processing_time, timestampdiff(MINUTE, crd.collection_time, fe.event_timestamp) as ischemia_time, 0 from catissue_specimen c inner join os_spmn_coll_recv_details crd on crd.primary_specimen_id = c.primary_specimen_id left join ( select fre.object_id as specimen_id, max(fep.event_timestamp) as event_timestamp from catissue_frozen_event_param fep inner join catissue_form_record_entry fre on fre.record_id = fep.identifier inner join catissue_form_context ffc on ffc.identifier = fre.form_ctxt_id inner join dyextn_containers ff on ff.identifier = ffc.container_id and ff.name = 'SpecimenFrozenEvent' group by fre.object_id ) fe on fe.specimen_id = c.primary_specimen_id where c.activity_status != 'Disabled' and c.collection_status = 'Collected';
update tmp_specimen_stats stats inner join ( select identifier, dense_rank() over (partition by specimen_collection_group_id, parent_specimen_id, specimen_type_id order by identifier) as specimen_seq from catissue_specimen where activity_status = 'Active' and availability_status = 'Available' ) t on t.identifier = stats.specimen_id set stats.specimen_seq = t.specimen_seq; end; //

changeSet.author: vpawar
changeSet.id: Populate specimen stats using collection receive details
changeSet.sql:
create or replace procedure populate_specimen_stats is begin execute immediate 'insert into tmp_specimen_stats ( specimen_id, collection_time, collection_procedure_id, collection_container_id, collector_id, received_time, received_quality_id, receiver_id, frozen_time, processing_time, ischemia_time, specimen_seq ) select c.identifier as specimen_id, crd.collection_time, crd.collection_procedure_id, crd.collection_container_id, crd.collection_user_id, crd.received_time, crd.received_quality_id, crd.received_user_id, fe.event_timestamp as frozen_time, round((cast(fe.event_timestamp as date) - cast(crd.received_time as date))*24*60) as processing_time, round((cast(fe.event_timestamp as date) - cast(crd.collection_time as date))*24*60) as ischemia_time, 0 from catissue_specimen c inner join os_spmn_coll_recv_details crd on crd.primary_specimen_id = c.primary_specimen_id left join ( select fre.object_id as specimen_id, max(fep.event_timestamp) as event_timestamp from catissue_frozen_event_param fep inner join catissue_form_record_entry fre on fre.record_id = fep.identifier inner join catissue_form_context ffc on ffc.identifier = fre.form_ctxt_id inner join dyextn_containers ff on ff.identifier = ffc.container_id and ff.name = ''SpecimenFrozenEvent'' group by fre.object_id ) fe on fe.specimen_id = c.primary_specimen_id where c.activity_status != ''Disabled'' and c.collection_status = ''Collected''';
execute immediate 'merge into tmp_specimen_stats stats using ( select identifier, dense_rank() over (partition by specimen_collection_group_id, parent_specimen_id, specimen_type_id order by identifier) as specimen_seq from catissue_specimen where activity_status = ''Active'' and availability_status = ''Available'' ) t on (t.identifier = stats.specimen_id) when matched then update set stats.specimen_seq = t.specimen_seq'; end; //
